<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow in mruby's VM: mrb_funcall_with_block (src/vm.c) can write past the end of a VM stack allocation. The VM fails to reserve sufficient stack/heap space when preparing/performing a method/function call (mrb_funcall_* path), allowing an 8-byte write beyond the allocated buffer. This leads to heap corruption and can cause crashes or potentially enable arbitrary code execution.
